meta.title: Premium — Fantasy and pools for the Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A and Bundesliga | Fantasy MX
meta.description: With Premium you play fantasy, pools and Survivor in the Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A and the Bundesliga, set your own rules and invite friends even if they don't pay. Liga MX stays free.

landing.heading: European football, with your friends
landing.subheading: All of Liga MX is free and always will be. Premium adds Europe's big four and the tools to run your tournament your way.

plans.heading: Pick your plan
plans.subheading: The same Premium in both; the yearly one works out cheaper per month.
plans.note: Cancel any time from the app. You keep Premium until the period you already paid for ends.

includes.heading: What Premium includes
includes.subheading: All of this comes on top of what you already play in Liga MX.

leagues.title: Europe's big four

survivor.title: Custom Survivor
survivor.detail: Create your own Survivor with your own rules and lives, in any league, on top of the official ones.

tools.title: Manager tools

guests.title: Bring your friends
guests.detail: Invite people without Premium to your European leagues, pools and Survivors: your subscription opens the door for them. In fantasy leagues, up to half the spots.

rows.feature: Liga MX: follow it and play all three modes
Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A and Bundesliga

items.a: No. Following it live and playing fantasy, pools and Survivor on Liga MX is free and will stay that way. Premium only adds things on top.

You keep Premium until the period you already paid for ends. After that you carry on playing what you already had — your leagues, lineups and predictions are untouched — but you can no longer create or join content in the European leagues.

items.q: Do my friends have to pay too?
items.a: Not necessarily. If you have Premium you can invite them to your European leagues, pools and Survivors even if they don't pay. Fantasy leagues have a split: up to half the spots can be people without Premium.
Payments are processed by Stripe. Your card details are captured in their forms and never pass through our servers.
